description: Send an email message to a recipient. Use when the user asks to send an email, message someone by email, contact by email, or communicate a written message via email.

example.subject: Meeting reminder
example.body: Hi Juan, this is a reminder for our meeting tomorrow at 10am.

to.description: Email address of the recipient (e.g. juan@example.com)

description: Create a new event or appointment in a calendar. Use when the user wants to schedule something, add an event, set a reminder, book an appointment, or create a calendar entry.

example.title: Dentist appointment
example.description: Annual dental checkup at Dr. Garcia's office

title.description: Title or summary of the event

start_time.description: Start date and time in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+TZ). REQUIRED — compute from user's words using today's date. Example: today is May 24, user says 'tomorrow at 10am' → 2026-05-25T10:00:00+02:00

end_time.description: End date and time in ISO 8601 format. If the user didn't specify an end time, set it to exactly 1 hour after start_time

description.description: Optional notes or details about the event

description: A mock tool for testing. Does nothing real — just echoes back the message parameter. Use when the user asks to test a tool, run a test, or echo something.
